description.en: The continuous neck enters from the bottom and right edge, with the ears, wink, muzzle, and rainbow tongue kept inside the rounded tile.
description.zh: 颈部从底部与右侧自然延伸出画面，耳朵、眨眼、鼻口和彩虹舌头完整留在圆角图标内。

description.en: Broad ivory and charcoal planes carry the familiar zebra. Smaller facets articulate the wink, dark nose, and little rainbow tongue.
description.zh: 大块象牙白与炭黑平面保留熟悉的斑马，细一些的切面刻画眨眼、深色鼻子与彩虹舌头。

description.en: Tapered stripes fan through the lilac negative space, with fine light edges and shallow shadows. Their geometry echoes the zebra’s markings and belongs only to Pew.
description.zh: 舒展的条纹掠过淡紫色留白，细亮边与浅阴影带出浮雕质感。纹样呼应斑马的条纹，为 Pew 单独设计。

sizeNote.en: At 16 px the striped silhouette leads; the wink and individual facets merge, while the rainbow tongue becomes a small color accent.
sizeNote.zh: 缩到 16 px 时，黑白条纹轮廓承担辨识度；眨眼与细碎切面会合并，彩虹舌头成为一小点彩色装饰。

goal.en: Understand AI coding-tool usage through token and session statistics, with analysis by time, model, device, and project.
goal.zh: 汇总 AI 编程工具的 token 与会话统计，按时间、模型、设备和项目分析使用情况。

description.en: Three tapered sweeps carry the zebra’s stripe rhythm into the surrounding space, with unequal gaps and open ends.
description.zh: 三道渐细的曲线疏密错落，将斑马条纹的节奏延伸到留白中。

alt.en: Zebra portrait with a rainbow tongue on a Hexly campaign canvas
alt.zh: Pew，置于 Hexly 宣发画布

description.en: Zebra portrait with a rainbow tongue.
description.zh: 探入画面的斑马头像，伸出一小段彩虹舌头。

description.en: Preserve the exact project identity and the separately recorded Hexly artwork. Hexly paper, ink and terracotta belong to archive and campaign surfaces only; independent product palettes and themes stay their own.
description.zh: 项目原标与单独记录的 Hexly 主视觉均保持形状和原色。Hexly 纸色、墨色和陶土色只用于档案及宣发画布，各产品色板与主题独立保留。

description.en: Keep the existing portrait's natural frame entry. The full square is placed against the baseline; no anatomy is extended, trimmed or masked. Keep external clear space of at least 1/8 of the mark canvas height around standalone marks and lockups. Wide and mobile Heroes are separate compositions of existing artwork, with no image-model call.
description.zh: 保留原头像自然入框的边界，将完整方形画布贴齐基线；不补画、不截取解剖结构。独立标志及字标组合四周，至少留出标志画布高度 1/8 的外部净空。宽幅与手机 Hero 分别排版，没有新图像模型调用。

description.en: Navigation 24px preferred, 16px minimum. Wordmark ≥51px wide; lockup ≥160px. Use transparent PNG/ICO at small sizes without a tile, extra red dot, shadow or rounded mask. Fine facets soften at 16px.
description.zh: 导航推荐 24px，最小 16px。字标宽度至少 51px，组合至少 160px。小尺寸使用透明 PNG/ICO，不加底板、红点、阴影或圆角遮罩；16px 时细小切面会柔化。
